a_before_b.rationale: Adapter-based finetuning is a specific parameter-efficient technique that does not require understanding learning rate scheduling to grasp its core mechanism of inserting trainable modules while freezing base parameters.

b_before_a.rationale: Learning rate scheduling is a general training optimization concept that can be understood independently of adapter-based finetuning, as it applies broadly to model training rather than being specific to adapter architectures.
